Dear Sales Team,

Regarding Sales Order 3260671 for ABC GROUP (INDIA) PRIVATE LIMITED, we have completed the stock dispatch analysis. 

The following products are confirmed and ready for processing with their assigned batches: OE1FJ 600x1200-2 EDISS WOOD MDR-P (Batch A-26), OV6FJ 600x1200-2 FRYETT NERO CRVMDR-P (Batch 30-07-2025), OA4FJ 600X600-4 COSTA WOOD CREMA SUMDR-P (Batch 20), OA4FJ 600X600-4 COLABA COFFEE MT REC-P (Batch 38), OE1FJ 600X1200-2 MAZONITE BLUE HGDGRE-P (Batch A-107), OV7FJ 600X1200-2 FIRMIN BLISS ANANSPDR-P (Batch CP-09), OE1FJ 600x1200-2 REXWOOD BRONZ MDR-P (Batch A-18), OE1FJ 600X1200-2 THOM BLUE HGDGRE-P (Batch A-65), and OA4FJ 600X600-4 COSTA WOOD WENGE SUMDR-P (Batch 32).

Regarding OOWJ 300X450-6 DOVER MESH HL GL -P, we are not in a position to supply the requested quantity of 200 as no stock is currently available. The sales team can choose to wait for the next production cycle or ignore this material to process the rest of the order.

Regarding OE1FJ 600X1200-2 ROYAL STATUARIO GLDGR-P, we are not in a position to supply the entire requested quantity of 200 units. However, we can offer 76 units covering multiple batches (A-38 and A-39). Alternatively, you may wait for the full stock to be replenished after production or choose to ignore this stock and process other materials in the SO.

Please let us know how you would like to proceed.
